verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a catalog and affiliate intermediary sitting between shopping agents and merchants, so merchant-side attribution of orders to agents is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence covers only developer-side attribution: Channel3 records sales and pays the agent builder a commission, and an optional user identifier can be appended to buy URLs. Nothing shows merchants receiving orders tagged with the originating agent, or being able to report on or filter transactions by agent.
